title: Local stability of Frobenius and Artin--Schreier base-change: a comparison
summary: Let $(X,Δ)\to C$ be a family of pairs over a smooth curve in positive characteristic $p>0$. We study the discrepancies of divisors over the base-change $(X,Δ)\to C$ along Artin--Schreier and Frobenius covers of $C$, through ramification data for Artin--Schreier and degree $p$ purely inseparable extensions of DVRs. As an application, we recover a result of Hu and Zong about permanence of local stability for such base-change.
